messages.subject: Quotation for the warehouse extension
messages.text:
Hello Jana,

we are extending hall B by about 600 m² and would like a quotation for the racking and the conveyor between the two halls. Could you send it by Thursday? The board meets on Friday.

The layout is roughly the one we discussed in September; I will send the current drawing as soon as our architect returns it.

Best regards,
Petr

messages.subject: Re: Quotation for the warehouse extension
messages.text:
Hello Petr,

Thursday morning is fine. I will put the extended warranty on a separate line, so that you can decide on it apart from the rest.

One question: do you want the conveyor with the roller section only, or with the belt for the small parcels as well? The belt adds about 12 % to the price.

Kind regards,
Jana

messages.subject: Re: Quotation for the warehouse extension

attachments.name: Hall-B-layout.pdf
attachments.text:
Hall B extension - layout
Scale 1:200
Racking rows R1-R6, conveyor C1
Acme Logistics, drawing 2026-10-21

messages.text:
Hello Jana,

the drawing is attached. The belt section yes, please, the small parcels are most of what goes through there.

Could you also include the lighting above the racking? Our electrician says it has to be in the same project.

Thanks,
Petr

messages.subject: Re: Quotation for the warehouse extension
messages.text:
Hello Petr,

yes, I will add the lighting as a third section; our electrical partner can quote it from the drawing. You will have the complete quotation on Friday by noon.

Kind regards,
Jana

messages.subject: Q4 planning meeting
messages.text:
Hi all,

let's go through the Q4 plan on Thursday: the Acme project, hiring for the assembly team and the budget for the new CAD licences. Jana, please bring the state of the quotations.

Tomáš

messages.subject: Design Weekly #212: typography on the desktop
messages.text:

messages.subject: Request for a quote: interior fit-out of the new studio
messages.text:
Dear Ms Dvořáková,

we found you through Acme Logistics, who recommended you warmly. We are moving our studio to a former workshop in Karlín (about 220 m²) and need the steel mezzanine, the railing and the stairs.

Would you be able to visit the site next week? We are flexible on Tuesday and Wednesday afternoon.

With kind regards,
Eva Králová

messages.text:
Hi Jana,

the second draft of the website copy is attached. I shortened the home page as you asked and moved the references under the services, so that each service has its own two or three.

The contact page still needs the opening hours of the workshop.

Ondřej

messages.subject: Re: Website copy, second draft
messages.text:
Hi Ondřej,

this reads much better, thank you. Two remarks:

- On the home page, "family firm since 1994" should be 1996, that is when the workshop opened.
- Under services, the mezzanines deserve their own paragraph; they are a third of our work now.

The workshop hours are 7:00 to 15:30, Monday to Friday.

Jana

The current website is from 2019 and does not work well on phones. The new one should present the three services (racking, mezzanines, conveyors) with references under each, and the contact page should carry the workshop hours.

Copy comes from Copywrite (Ondřej Vlk), photos from the hall A installation.

issues.summary: Field app: measurements lost without a signal
issues.description:
When the crew measures a hall without a mobile signal, the app loses the measurements on the next sync instead of keeping them. Happened twice at Acme hall B.

Expected: measurements are stored locally and uploaded when the signal returns.

comments.author: martin
comments.html: Reproduced: the sync overwrites the local database with the server copy when the server is reachable again. Fix in progress.

comments.author: me
comments.html: Thanks. Can it be in the next release? The crew is at Acme again on the 10th.

comments.author: martin
comments.html: Yes, the fix is in testing; release planned for Monday.

issues.description: Since the router update the VPN drops every twenty minutes or so, usually in the middle of a CAD session. Home office, Vodafone connection.

comments.author: martin
comments.html: Please try the new profile I sent you and tell me if it still drops.
